allReviewedPassages.rawText: Important — skills/super-code/coordinator.js:432: The verification guard compares verified.sourceTree only against the current event's observed record. A normal verification-only reply omits observed, so !observed makes the guard true even if that exact source tree and command/configuration already has a retained live/fail observation. Concrete history: the existing fixture establishes baseline a/pass, A source b/fail and owner bd-A; append a reply with evidence [b/live/pass] and an association containing verification:0 but no observed/runBaseline. The reducer retains the original b/fail comparison, sets state=verified, and records no contradiction gap. This is the same immutable tested source as the recorded failure, not evidence of a repaired source; the contradictory outcomes need reconciliation. Callers explicitly retire the qualifier on this verified state, so the open repair can disappear. Compare the verification source/outcome against retained linked observations (and other associated outcomes), preserve ownership/open state with a contradiction gap when they conflict, and add a deterministic fixture for verification-only contradiction after durable re-entry. If repeat measurements are intentionally reconciled, require explicit supported reconciliation rather than silently accepting the later pass. The within-one-event baseline/observed same-tree guard does not cover this durable-history path.

allReviewedPassages.rawText: Risk: a reducer that is unreachable from real review handling would not implement ownership. Traced reviewAndFix -> validReview -> dispatch(schema RESULT) -> recordCheckEvidence/recordFailureAttribution -> noteRecovery, and final return -> runFailures. Searched sibling RESULT dispatches: the centralized dispatch hook applies to them as well. Read only this focused caller and the changed classifier to check the source-conflict risk. The classifier at lines 410-435 confirms that verification-only events bypass the sole same-source guard; durable prior evidence is available in data.history but is not consulted by that guard.
